name: Rolling Stone
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level druid 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (a small stone sphere)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect 5-ft.-diameter sphere

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

A smooth, stone sphere rolls in whichever direction you point and crushes those in its way. It moves 30 feet per round. As part of this movement, it can ascend or jump up to 30 feet to strike a target. If it enters a space with a creature, it stops moving for the round and deals 8d6 points of bludgeoning damage to that creature that is reduced by 2d6 per size category over Medium, though a successful Reflex save negates that damage. A rolling stone rolls over barriers less than 4 feet tall. The sphere has an AC of 5, hardness of 8, and 500 hit points.

The sphere moves as long as you actively direct it (a move action for you); otherwise, it merely stays at rest.

It cannot push aside unwilling creatures or batter down large obstacles. A rolling stone turns to dust if it exceeds the spell’s range.
